$comment: The illustrative 'glass' icons this library ships, by their path under assets/glass-icons/.
These are the 64px illustrations the Figma card puts in a 48px container — a different set from
the MingCute UI glyphs in manifest.json, and not interchangeable with them.
Run `pnpm glass-icons` after editing. Set "icons" to "*" to generate all 165.
Two icons whose file names match (Dashboard, Analytics, Integration, Pricing, Global Services)
need an { "path": "...", "as": "..." } entry to tell their components apart.
